item.text: The disposition records distinguish verified decisions for a whole document from decisions about only part of it. I’ll use those records and their linked decision meetings. I’ll also follow revision links through all later versions and match the stated releases and clause numbers.

import json,collections,re
qs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('questions.jsonl')]
targets={'tdoc:'+x for x in re.findall(r'R3-\\d+','\\n'.join(x['question'] for x in qs))}
roots=['R3-194791','R3-212949','R3-222937','R3-255965']
targets.update('tdoc:'+x for x in roots)
for f in ['records/phase-4/crpacks.jsonld','records/phase-4/cr_extensions.jsonld','records/phase-4/section_extensions.jsonld']:
 with open(f) as h: g=json.load(h)['@graph']
 print('FILE',f)
 for x in g:
  links=x.get('hasCR',x.get('modifiedByCR',[]));links=links if isinstance(links,list) else [links]
  if (set(links)&targets) or x['@id'] in targets:
   keep=[k for k in x if k not in ['tdoc:reasonForChange','tdoc:summaryOfChange','tdoc:consequencesIfNotApproved']]
   print(json.dumps({k:x[k] for k in keep},ensure_ascii=False))
PY"

 print(q['id'],'raw clause audit:')
 for doc,item in namespace['tdocs'].items():
  if namespace['releases'].get(item.get('targetRelease'))"'!=release:continue
  if item.get('"'modifies')"'!='"'tdoc:spec/'+spec.replace('.','_'):continue
  clauses=re.findall(r'(?<"'!['"\\d.])'+re.escape(clause)+r'(?"'!['"\\d.])',item.get('tdoc:clausesAffected',''))
  if clauses and doc not in set(namespace['clause_candidates'](spec,clause,release)):
   print(doc,repr(item['tdoc:clausesAffected']),'dispositions',namespace['dispositions'][doc],'packs',namespace['document_packs'][doc])

I interpreted each JSON-LD `@graph` as records joined through document, decision, meeting, pack, and section identifiers. Dispositions required `evidenceStatus: source_verified` and assessment scope `whole_target`; meetings came from their linked decision events. I followed revision links transitively, used explicit pack memberships and clause links, and matched release questions against the CR’s target release. Document-list statuses were kept separate from decision dispositions.
